facts.name: FMemory_Free
facts.note: The call FieldTick makes right after the tracker dispatch to free its overlap array (1.004 0x140A56362 -> 0x14079F8D0, 1.005 0x140935B7B -> 0x141994540); the same prologue apart from the __chkstk displacement. Read by capstone from both exes (main session, 2026-10-08).

facts.name: FieldTick's scratch set clear
facts.note: Called by FieldTick on its scratch set before each tracker when the set holds anything (1.004 0x140A5632C, 1.005 0x140935B44); identical first 24 bytes. The reset that follows (Num, FirstFree -1, NumFree, hash count) is the same in both builds.

facts.name: call site: diff -> TriggerMgr_OnTrackerEnter_Filter
facts.note: rcx manager (g_EndGameRoot+0x178), rdx key, r8 owner (the trigger actor, from the tracker's +0 weak), r9 weak actor. 1.004 bytes E845B3F9FF at +0x6 of its block; 1.005 at +0xD, crossing into the next block (InstallFromOwnThread).

facts.name: call site: diff -> TriggerMgr_OnTrackerLeave_Filter
facts.note: Same arguments as the enter filter. 1.004 bytes E8F2AFF9FF at +0xD (crosses); 1.005 at +0xB, inside one block.
